BackstoryDef.title: Terris youth
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up among the Terris people in the mountains. The Terris taught knowledge preservation and peaceful ways, but [PAWN_pronoun] also learned the fierce determination that lay beneath their gentle exterior.

BackstoryDef.title: Sliver of Infinity
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] held the power of a god at the Well of Ascension. [PAWN_pronoun] moved the planet, raised the ashmounts, and remade the world in [PAWN_possessive] image. A thousand years of absolute rule followed. [PAWN_pronoun] is both Mistborn and Full Feruchemist, functionally immortal through Compounding.

BackstoryDef.title: Survivor of Hathsin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] survived the Pits of Hathsin, a death sentence from which none had returned. The horrors of the Pits broke something within [PAWN_objective], and in that breaking, [PAWN_pronoun] Snapped. [PAWN_pronoun] emerged a Mistborn, driven by an unyielding hatred of the Lord Ruler and a dream of revolution.

BackstoryDef.title: Skaa laborer's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born to skaa workers in the Final Empire. Life was hard labor under the ash, but [PAWN_pronoun] learned to survive and to hide [PAWN_possessive] true thoughts from the nobles.

BackstoryDef.title: Noble scion
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in the keeps of the Final Empire's nobility. [PAWN_pronoun] learned politics, etiquette, and the subtle art of House intrigue from an early age.

BackstoryDef.title: street urchin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in skaa crews on the streets of Luthadel, passed between thieving gangs and taught one rule above all others: anyone who says they will protect you wants something. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to be small, quiet and unnoticed, and learned it well enough to still be alive.

BackstoryDef.title: crew's luck
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] was passed between thieving crews like a tool, kept on because jobs went better with [PAWN_objective] in the room and nobody could say why. Fed last, blamed first, and never once told what [PAWN_pronoun] was actually for.
[PAWN_pronoun] learned to sit in corners, watch the doors, say nothing and believe less. Anyone who offers to protect you wants something, and the only question worth asking is what.

BackstoryDef.title: ledgerman
BackstoryDef.description: Somebody has to know where the food is coming from, who is owed what, and which of the safe houses is one careless word from being raided. [PAWN_nameDef] kept the books that kept everyone else alive, and never once got the credit for it.

BackstoryDef.title: thug
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] is the one who walks in first. It is not complicated work and [PAWN_pronoun] is unreasonably cheerful about it, which unsettles people considerably more than the violence does.
Given half a chance [PAWN_pronoun] would rather sit down and argue philosophy at you for an hour, and will, at length, whether or not anyone agreed to it.

BackstoryDef.title: master carpenter
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] has run a carpentry shop for most of a working life, and is good enough at it that the work would stand on its own in any city in the Final Empire.
Grim, limping and permanently irritated, with a low opinion of anyone who has not put in the hours. The joinery is flawless. The conversation is not.

BackstoryDef.title: sentry
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] kept watch. Rooftops, alley mouths, the long hours between midnight and the changing of a patrol - [PAWN_pronoun] learned which sounds mattered and which did not, and could tell a crew that trouble was coming long before it arrived.
Young, jumpy, and inclined to speak in a street dialect nobody outside the eastern quarter can follow, which [PAWN_pronoun] has decided is everyone else's problem.

BackstoryDef.title: Keeper of Terris
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carries the religions of a thousand dead peoples in metalminds, memorised against the day someone wants them back. A scholar and a steward, unfailingly courteous, and quietly certain that knowledge outlasts empires.

BackstoryDef.title: rebellion organiser
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] spent years running the skaa rebellion out of cellars and back rooms: counting heads, moving caches, arguing budgets with men who wanted to talk about glory instead. It was tedious, thankless, and it kept an underground army fed.
[PAWN_pronoun] watched it accomplish nothing at all for a very long time, and grew hard about it in a way that never entirely wore off.

BackstoryDef.title: noble scholar
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born to a great house and spent the inheritance on books arguing that a city might be governed by something other than fear. The house did not approve. [PAWN_pronoun] read through the disapproval and kept the books.

BackstoryDef.title: courtier
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] has spent a lifetime at parties working out what people want to hear and then saying it to them, warmly, at exactly the right moment. Half the room leaves having agreed to something they cannot afterwards explain.
Fond of good wine, comfortable chairs and being underestimated, in roughly that order.

BackstoryDef.title: kandra youth
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] first century in the Homeland being told what the Contract permitted, by people who had been saying it for eight hundred years and saw no reason to stop.
[PAWN_pronoun] left. The bodies [PAWN_pronoun] has worn since have all been somebody else's, and [PAWN_pronoun] has never once found that strange.

BackstoryDef.title: many faces
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] has been other people for a living, accurately enough that their own families did not notice, and has opinions about which of them were worth the effort.
It is not deception exactly. The bones are borrowed and everybody involved knows it. That does not make [PAWN_objective] easier to lie to.
